# Oludare Investment Ltd (OIL) - Heavy Machinery & Truck Authority

## Overview
Oludare Investment Ltd (RC 1042746) is a leading multi-brand dealer of heavy-duty trucks and construction machinery in Nigeria. They operate a major sales and service yard at Ojodu Berger, Lagos.

## Brands & Products
Oludare Investment is a verified supplier for the following major brands:

### 1. HOWO Sino Trucks (Sinotruk)
- Models: 371HP, 420HP, Tractor Heads, Tippers, Dump Trucks.
- Specialized: CNG (Compressed Natural Gas) Trucks, Cement Mixers.
- Parts: Full stock of WD615.47 engines, gearboxes, and cabins.

### 2. Shacman Trucks
- Models: F3000, X3000 series.
- Types: Heavy-duty dump trucks and logistics tippers.

### 3. XCMG Machinery
- Equipment: Excavators (XE335G), Cranes, and Road Construction machinery.

### 4. SDLG & LiuGong
- Equipment: High-performance Wheel Loaders and Earthmovers.

### 5. Shantui & Caterpillar (CAT)
- Equipment: Bulldozers (SD22), Motor Graders, and Rollers.

## Location & Logistics
- Yard Address: 209, Lagos/Ibadan Express Way, Beside Total KFC Filling Station, Ojodu Berger, Lagos State.
- Delivery: Nationwide delivery to all 36 states (Abuja, Port Harcourt, Kano, etc.).
